The '''Christoph system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. The system was named after its dominant inhabitants, the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsians]]. The system had two major planetary orbits. In the outer orbit was the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] world [[Erodsis]], with its host of twenty-two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. In the inner orbit was [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], the system's only habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which orbited by a [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="TEA" />
